item.title: Team’s Up – Iheanacho returns for Celtic must win
item.description: Celtic manager Martin O’Neill has named his team for this evening’s crucial Europa League clash with FC Utrecht. The Dutch side arrive having already been eliminated from the competition. O’Neill has pulled no surprises with his starting XI. However, Celtic are bolstered by the return of Nigerian striker Kelechi Iheanacho, who starts from the bench. Read More

item.description: Vasilis Barkas has been named in the Utrecht starting XI for this evening’s UEFA Europa League clash with Celtic. item.title: Celtic to face either Ferencvaros or Stuttgart in Europa League Playoff
item.description: Celtic will face either Stuttgart or Ferencvaros in the UEFA Europa League Knockout Playoff Round. The Scottish Champions booked their place in the next phase of the competition after a 4-2 win against Utrecht at Celtic Park.
